summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of Sanjeevni MVP. 31/31 backend pytest tests pass. Frontend critical flows (landing, auth — email/admin/pharmacy/OTP, medicines list/search/Rx filter/detail, add-to-cart, cart, doctor consultation booking, prescriptions, profile, admin dashboard, pharmacy panel, logout, orders list, order tracking) all working. Checkout/place-order verified end-to-end via backend API; the UI place-order test had one flaky DOM-detachment but the order successfully persisted and appears in /orders.

minor.issue: Pydantic EmailStr rejects reserved TLDs like .test (returns 422). Acceptable behavior; just use real-looking domains in tests.

issues: Recharts emits 'width(-1) and height(-1)' warnings on initial render — chart container has no fixed height before data loads. Cosmetic only; chart renders correctly after.

action_items: (Optional) Set explicit min-height on Recharts ResponsiveContainer wrapper in AdminDashboard to silence -1 width/height warnings.

(Optional security hardening) CORS is configured with allow_origins=['*'] and allow_credentials=True — works behind the Emergent preview proxy but is technically invalid per spec; tighten origins for production.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 713-line file mixing auth, catalog, cart, orders, admin, pharmacy and seed — split into modules (auth.py, catalog.py, orders.py, admin.py, seed.py) for maintainability when scaling.

Cookies set with secure=False and samesite='lax'. Cross-site browser usage typically requires SameSite=None; Secure=True. It works in this preview because the frontend and backend share the same origin via Kubernetes ingress, but this will break in any true cross-origin deployment.
No brute-force lockout on /auth/login — playbook recommends 5-fail lockout. Currently every wrong attempt only returns 401 with no rate-limiting.

seed_users only updates password if it changed; good. But there is no protection if seeded preset emails are claimed by a regular registration (race-free because users.email unique index exists — verified).
/api/coupons/apply uses query param `code` instead of JSON body — works but inconsistent with the rest of the JSON-body API style.
checkout decrements wallet but does not record a wallet transaction in db.wallet_txns (which is read in /api/wallet) — the user will never see a wallet history.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (13/14 first pass; place-order DOM detach was test flake — order verified placed via API and /orders list)

Frontend selectors verified: data-testid='landing-page', 'login-email', 'login-password', 'login-submit', 'login-phone', 'send-otp-btn', 'login-otp', 'verify-otp-btn', 'medicines-grid', 'medicine-search-input' (NOT 'medicines-search'), 'rx-only-toggle', 'qty-inc/dec', 'cart-count', 'consult-d1', 'slot-*', 'confirm-book-btn', 'addr-line1/city/state/pincode/label', 'save-address-btn', 'place-order-btn', 'nav-user-menu', 'menu-logout'. Place-order via UI works end-to-end (order appears in /orders) — re-run with explicit small waits between cart-add and navigation to /checkout to avoid DOM detach flake.
rca of the issue: Single backend test failure (initially) was test-data, not app: Pydantic EmailStr rejects '.test' reserved TLD. Switched to '@example.com' and test passes. No app bug.
